description: Product-type narrative templates for Amazon A+ long-detail generation. These templates sit above category visual profiles and decide the selling-story structure.

pet-travel-hydration.label: Pet travel hydration bottle
pet-travel-hydration.narrative_core: Outdoor thirst solved in one hand: dispense water, let pets drink, return unused water, and carry without leaks.
pet-travel-hydration.shopper_tension: Pet owners need fast hydration outdoors but do not want to carry a separate bowl, waste water, or risk leaks in a bag or car.
visual_principles: Each section must have a distinct selling job and a different visual composition.
Do not repeat one generic pet lifestyle scene across all sections.
Prefer action moments, mechanism close-ups, and before-after problem framing over flat specification cards.
Keep exact specs for the rational confirmation section; use earlier sections to dramatize use and benefit.

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Open with the outdoor thirst problem and the product as the immediate one-hand solution.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: dynamic outdoor walking or trail moment, pet clearly thirsty or pausing for water, owner holding beige portable bottle as the hero object, strong Amazon A+ hero composition
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Pets get thirsty outdoors and owners need water immediately without carrying a separate bowl.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: A small or medium dog pauses on a walk or trail while the owner raises the portable water bottle ready to dispense.

image_copy_gate.proof_line: Portable water for dogs and cats

a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 首屏直接建立户外补水问题
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留干净户外光影背景，承接一键出水动作

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Show the one-button, one-hand dispense action as the main functional benefit.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: macro action shot of thumb pressing the button, water flowing into the drinking cup trough, pet muzzle nearby but not covering the product
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Owners need to give water quickly while holding a leash or bag.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Close-up of a hand pressing the button with water visibly filling the cup trough.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接户外场景背景
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留浅色产品特写背景，承接回流水路

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Explain the unused-water return mechanism as the standout differentiator.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: split action diagram or clean mechanism cutaway showing water dispensed into trough and unused water returning to bottle, arrows only inside the middle safe area
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Outdoor water is limited, and leftover water should not be wasted.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Two-step visual: water out to drink, leftover water back into the bottle.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接按键出水特写
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留干净浅色功能图背景，承接防漏携带

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Address the bag/car leak anxiety with the lock and seal structure.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: travel bag or car cup holder scene, bottle closed with lock emphasized, subtle seal-ring callout, premium practical travel layout
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Owners worry water bottles may leak inside bags, cars, or camping gear.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Closed bottle placed in a backpack side pocket or car cup holder with lock detail highlighted.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接功能图浅色背景
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留车载或背包场景背景，承接容量场景

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Connect 550mL capacity to real walking, hiking, camping, travel, and car outing use.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: multi-scenario strip or map-like outdoor day layout showing walk, hike, camping, road trip with the same bottle as anchor
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Owners need enough water for short outdoor outings without carrying bulky gear.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: The bottle appears as the consistent anchor across walking, hiking, camping, and car travel scenes.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留温暖户外背景，承接宠物适配

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Show the drinking trough and use height fitting small dogs, medium dogs, and cats.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: three-pet fit composition: small dog, medium dog, cat, all interacting with or near the bottle in separate clean panels
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Shoppers need confidence that the cup shape works for their pet size.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Small dog, medium dog, and cat each shown with the cup trough in a clean comparison layout.

image_copy_gate.proof_line: Suitable for small dogs, medium dogs, and cats

a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接户外温暖背景
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留浅色宠物适配背景，承接规格确认

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Provide rational confirmation with material, size, weight, and package facts.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: clean product specification layout, bottle silhouette with dimension marks, material stack PC body ABS lid silicone seal, concise table for size and weight
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: After the benefit story, shoppers need exact material and size checks before buying.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Product silhouette with dimension lines and a premium spec table.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接宠物适配背景
a-plus-lite-8.transition_out: 底部保留规格页浅色背景，承接出行套装收尾

a-plus-lite-8.frame_objective: Close with the ready-to-go kit: bottle, lanyard, compact package, and travel confidence.
a-plus-lite-8.prompt_focus: final organized travel kit scene with bottle and lanyard, package-size cue, warm outdoor light, single concise closing headline
a-plus-lite-8.shopper_tension: Shoppers want a simple complete kit they can take out immediately.
a-plus-lite-8.visual_moment: Bottle and lanyard arranged as a compact travel kit beside a leash or backpack.
a-plus-lite-8.transition_in: 顶部承接规格页浅色背景
